(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix Notification Center Connector. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/notification-center/connectors/.
config_overrides  nested LIST computed
    description: The config overrides. Removing this block keeps the value until another attribute changes. Set `config_overrides = []` to clear it.
config_overrides.entity_type  tftypes.String computed
    description: Entity type for the connector. Valid values are: unspecified, alerts, cases, test_notifications.
config_overrides.fields  nested SET computed
    description: List of fields. The server does not keep the order of the fields.
config_overrides.fields.field_name  tftypes.String computed
    description: The field name.
config_overrides.fields.template  tftypes.String computed
    description: Template.
connector_config  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Configuration for a specific output schema of a connector
connector_config.field_values_wo  tftypes.Map[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Secret values for connector fields, keyed by field name, which Terraform sends to the API and never writes to state. A field named here must not also appear in `fields`. Each entry needs a matching entry in `field_values_wo_versions`. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later.\n\nImporting is the one exception. An import has neither configuration nor prior state, so nothing identifies which field is a secret, and the API returns every field's value: the secret is written to state by the import itself. The following apply removes it again. Treat a secret that has been through an import as exposed, and rotate it. Reading the same connector through `data.coralogix_connector` also returns the value, under `connector_config.fields`: a data source reads from the API and has no configuration telling it which value is managed write-only.
connector_config.field_values_wo_versions  tftypes.Map[tftypes.Number] computed
    description: Version of each `field_values_wo` entry, keyed by the same field name. Increment a value to send a rotated secret: Terraform holds no copy of a write-only value, so it cannot notice that one changed. These versions are kept in state and are not secret.
connector_config.fields  nested SET computed
    description: List of fields. The server does not keep the order of the fields.
connector_config.fields.field_name  tftypes.String computed
    description: The field name.
connector_config.fields.value  tftypes.String computed
    description: The value.
description  tftypes.String computed
    description: Human-readable description. The API stores an omitted description as an empty string, so Terraform treats this field as Optional and Computed with a default of `""`. Removing the attribute clears it.
id  tftypes.String optional
    description: Connector ID. Can be set by the user or generated by Coralogix. Requires recreation in case of change.
name  tftypes.String optional,computed
    description: Connector name.
type  tftypes.String computed
    description: Connector type. Valid values are: unspecified, slack, generic_https, pagerduty, pagerduty_incidents, email, service_now, microsoft_teams, eventbridge, incident_io. `incident_io` is a preview type.
